gpt-5-mini.standardized_narrative: At 31 December 2015 the syndicate's opening gross claims reserves were GBP 342.27m. During 2015 the syndicate recorded an overall gross release in ultimate claims of GBP 27.1m (7.9% of opening gross claims), driven principally by favourable development in third party liability (casualty) reserves and the release of catastrophe loadings on 2014 as policies came off risk. The syndicate also highlights prior catastrophe activity (notably 2010/11 international cat events and Superstorm Sandy) as material prior exposures; the net effect in 2015 was a favourable run-off overall despite some deterioration in motor and other lines in prior periods.

gpt-5-mini.data_quality_notes: Primary prior year development figure (-GBP 27.1m) taken from Note 'Risk Management / Claims development' text describing an 'overall surplus in ultimate claims of GBP 27.1m'. The report also contains net reserve movement statements (e.g. net releases) and Reinsurance to Close (RITC) activity which can distort triangles; where both gross and net figures appear the gross phrasing was prioritised. Some LOB-specific movements are described qualitatively (e.g. third party liability release, motor deterioration) but not quantified by gross amount in the notes; where only net or narrative figures exist they were not used for the gross prior year development. Confidence scores reflect explicitness of the source (1.0=explicit table value; 0.8=clear textual gross statement; 0.5=inferred or not quantified).
